review_requirements: Confirm the exact EVAC-HF title, NCT01757067 and 2011-09-17 identity and chronology match between the independent protocol and analysis document.
Adjudicate the complete primary LVEF model, baseline and center adjustment, effect estimate and interval.
Review the baseline-EF imputation and on-successful-treatment analysis without allowing either to replace the randomized treatment effect.
Resolve the six-month anchor, estimand, missing-data sensitivity, multiplicity and safety-population decisions.
Verify every critical locator against the rendered one-based physical PDF pages.
